header.co_column_assumption: The column headed 'CO initial ambient composition' is treated as carbon dioxide (CO2). The PSI file does not say so; this is an assumption, to be confirmed by a chemist (DOB-51).
header.si_note: Generated by pipeline/flame_temperature/build.py, a script written with SI assistance (Claude Code, Anthropic). The humans chose the idea and the method.
header.ceiling_temperature: adiabatic flame temperature, fuel burned completely in the gas, start 298.15 K, constant pressure and enthalpy equilibrium (Cantera)
header.gas_label_rule: helium above 0.01 of the mixture, else carbon dioxide above 0.01, else nitrogen only
header.share_burned_rule: 1 - (diameter at flame-out / diameter at start)^3, clipped to 0..1; empty when either diameter is missing (flag incomplete)
